Megan: FYI — Newbridge just dropped their RFI and the security questionnaire. Asking for capability matrix, POC scope, and clarified pricing for Dedicated vs Private (on‑prem HSM). Can we get a concise pack by EOD Wed? They flagged SSO + HSM + low-latency SLA as deal blockers.
Arjun: I'll own the capability matrix and pricing tiers. Carmen please add HSM/KMS answers + sample SOW language. Ryan can you add fallback model variants and perf notes?
Carmen: Yep. Quick draft language for HSM section (paste below). I'll also attach the KMIP integration notes.
```
HSM / KMS answers (draft):
- Private: supports on‑prem HSM integration via KMIP (customer‑managed). Redwood provides connectors for PKCS#11 and KMIP gateways.
- Dedicated: BYO HSM via peered VPC + strict route policies; Redwood manages TLS endpoints, customer holds keys in HSM.
- Hosted: managed KMS with envelope encryption; HSM-backed key material available under Enterprise add‑on.
- Audit: all operations emit audit events to customer SIEM (S3/Logstash/CloudWatch).
```
Devon: POC timeline suggestion — propose 3 weeks total:
- Week 0: Legal/NDAs + network preflight
- Week 1: Infra provision + baseline functional tests
- Week 2: Load/latency benchmarks (50–200 qps), KV/prefix cache tuning
- Week 3: Results review, config handoff, and recommendations (quant/ batching/ routing)
SecurityBot: Uploaded Newbridge_Security_Q_2026.xlsx to Drives -> https://drive.redwood/internal/newbridge/RFI (QA + checklist).
Arjun: Matrix CSV snippet for the RFI (will expand into doc):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,99.9% (standard),99.95% (SLA),Customer-defined (platform install)
HSM,Managed KMS (hosted),BYO HSM (dedicated),On-prem HSM (private)
SSO (SAML/OIDC),Yes,Yes,Yes
Latency (typical gen),~40–80ms,~30–60ms,Depends on infra
Model pinning,No,Yes,Yes
Volume pricing,Usage-based,Reserved capacity,Enterprise license
```
Arjun: For pricing notes — propose two POC tiers: "Eval" (short-term hosted credits + small dedicated burst) and "Pilot" (1‑month dedicated capacity at prorated reserved rate). I'll add numbers to the matrix after Carmen's HSM notes.
Ryan: Technical note for the security questions — we should call out automatic fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity degrades, route to compatible quantized variant or hosted pool (customer opt-in). Also mention our KV prefix caching can reduce token costs on repetitive queries.
Carmen: Legal/contract ask: Newbridge requires data residency statement for their EU tenants. Suggest adding: "Data for EU customers processed in EU regions; Private installs remain in-customer network."
Megan: Great — packing this now. I'll assemble the zip: capability_matrix.csv, security_answers.docx, poc_timeline.md, and sample SOW. Expect upload within 2 hours. @Devon can you do a quick read on the SOW before I send to sales rep? :thumbsup:
Devon: Yep, will review in 30m.
Megan: Thanks team. If anything else pops up ping me in thread or DM. :eyes:
